properties.name: San José del Cabo
properties.notes: Trip start (drop-off). Full resupply, ATMs, small bike shop in town + high-end Specialized dealer at the south end. Airport ~1 mi off route.

properties.name: Turn for Los Cerritos
properties.notes: Junction for the optional 16 mi round-trip detour to Playa Los Cerritos (best surf beach on the cape; beach camping).

properties.name: Todos Santos
properties.notes: DRY-CARRY START → El Rosario (33.7 mi / 54 km, the loop's longest dry stretch — no reliable water on the climb). Full resupply, snowbird town; good place to top off everything.

properties.name: El Rosario
properties.notes: Limited food + water, a few miles before the pavement. First reliable water after the long Todos Santos climb.

properties.name: Turn to El Triunfo
properties.notes: El Triunfo is 1.5 mi east of the route — restored mining town, several small stores and two sit-down eateries. Important resupply.

properties.name: Los Divisaderos
properties.notes: Limited food + water on the scenic dirt road before the long descent into La Paz.

properties.name: La Paz
properties.notes: DRY-CARRY START → Los Divisaderos (30.3 mi / 49 km, climbing out of La Paz). Rest-day hub — whale shark tours, full resupply, ATMs, bike shop, capital of BCS.

properties.name: San Juan de los Planes
properties.notes: Food, water, restaurant. Last good resupply before the rocky coastal road to the East Cape.

properties.name: El Cardonal
properties.notes: Limited food, water, motel, camping, restaurant along the scenic Sea of Cortez coast road.

properties.name: Punta Pescadero
properties.notes: Motel only — no reliable food resupply.

properties.name: Los Barriles
properties.notes: Largest East Cape resupply: full grocery (turn up the main street for the supermarket), ATM, bike shop. Load up here AND La Ribera before Cabo Pulmo.

properties.name: La Ribera
properties.notes: DRY-CARRY START → Cabo Pulmo (20.1 mi / 32 km). Cabo Pulmo is limited — load PAST it here. Food, water, motel, restaurant.

properties.name: Cabo Pulmo
properties.notes: DRY-CARRY START → Palo Escopeta (26.2 mi / 42 km, big climb day, only a tiny stop at the end). No grocery — just two restaurants. World-class snorkeling + favorite singletrack.

properties.name: Turn to Playa El Arbolitos
properties.notes: Junction for Playa Los Arbolitos — beach camping, showers, scenic snorkeling coves, occasional fish tacos & water.

properties.name: Palo Escopeta
properties.notes: Tiny store, limited hours. Last stop before the descent back to San José del Cabo (~10 mi further).
